verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notetaker, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only a cloud-hosted service (api.fireflies.ai, cloud transcription) with no on-prem or self-hosted deployment option. Enterprise 'Private Storage' lets customers choose where meeting data is stored, but it is an adjacent data-residency feature, not self-hosting of the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
